mapper.sql: id , channel_num, channel_data_total, channel_throughput, channel_lag, channel_arrival_rate, channel_access_time, p_date
mapper.insert: insert into spider_report (id, channel_num, channel_data_total, channel_throughput, channel_lag, channel_arrival_rate, channel_access_time, p_date) values (#{id}, #{channelNum}, #{channelDataTotal}, #{channelThroughput}, #{channelLag}, #{channelArrivalRate}, #{channelAccessTime}, #{pDate})
mapper.select: select c.channel_num, a.channel_data_total, b.channel_throughput, b.channel_lag, a.channel_arrival_rate, c.channel_access_time from (select sum(collect_amount) as channel_data_total, avg(arrival_rate) as channel_arrival_rate from spider_data_amount_summary where p_date=#{pDate}) a, (select sum(record.rate) as channel_throughput,avg(record.lag) as channel_lag from (select channel_id,max(deal_rate) as rate ,max(lag_time) as lag from metric_record where metric_date=#{pDate} GROUP BY channel_id) record) b, (select avg(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,start_time,end_time)) as channel_access_time,count(1) as channel_num from spider_data_channel where state=1 ) c
